geometry_conflict.statement: Current HEC-1 train/eval roster requires two disjoint faces of 20 series (40 unique IDs per standard block). NOAA fresh v1 supplies 20 unique station IDs, of which 16 passed the prior health screen and 3 of the remaining 4 are near-empty on authorized record.json finiteness counts. 20 unique IDs cannot be 40 unique IDs. Repeating stations, treating windows as extra series, or mixing 2024/2025 is forbidden.
what_20_stations_can_do_without_padding: One 12+8 old-NOAA-scale cell (20 total, no 20/20 faces).
The existing 12+4 P4-Evolution cell (16 total, no face swap).
At most one 10+10 ForecastCell-style swap cell if a method ruling accepts half the HEC-1 served count.
what_20_stations_cannot_do: Phase S + Phase T six-block geometry.
geometry_conflict.not_a_ruling: Whether M0-b should shrink the NOAA cell, skip NOAA for HEC-1-scale comparison, or wait for Wind, is a method decision. This pack only records the conflict.
